name: Dana's magic broom
slug: Dana's magic broom from the white dragon hoard, flying 50 feet.
description: Dana's magic broom, taken from the white dragon hoard. It is the magic item she wrote down for herself from that treasure. Its flight is 50 feet.

log.summary: Dana leaves the tower on the broom toward the beacon. Glimmen overtakes her. Afterward she stomps through the group smacking people with it.
notes: Dana received it from the white dragon hoard. It is the magic item she wrote down for herself from that treasure.
Its flight is 50 feet. She leaves the tower on it toward the beacon and is overtaken by Glimmen. Afterward she stomps through the group smacking people with it.
